focus: mimo-01: Grading AI responses, what the operator gets

label: The D4 grader factory returns {score, confidence, parse_status} and already takes a grader kind; a jev kind slots in at score-model-variant.cjs:207-226, and an unknown kind silently becomes mock at :211

Reviewer fixtures carry the hidden-oracle gold (expectedVerdict plus expectedFindings) with hidden cases as the overfit guard, so the grading agreement metric has a denominator only after the fixtures are counted on disk

A grader exception returns score 0.0 confidence 0.0 parse_status failed, so a no-key or failed jev call would read as maximal hallucination instead of not-measured; the jev arm must report a visible skip
Grader selection is already an opt-in flag --grader noop|mock|llm with default noop at run-benchmark.cjs:577,582, so the jev arm needs no new knob and no-key behavior is the untouched default

The reply harness never calls a model and leaves the blinded judge slot empty (judge human or model), so a jev judge is measured against a human pass subset without ever serving its score to the compare gate
Live per-turn reply grading and playbook verdict grading fail the UX test: they add a per-turn number or a report row nobody acts on, and no gold set grades live replies
